question: Should iPhone realtime Talk remain a Chat action from the unified-chat design, or should the product adopt this PR’s persistent Assistant Chat/Talk mode?
rationale: Both paths are viable UI designs, but they establish different long-lived navigation and session-ownership contracts that cannot be selected safely by a mechanical rebase.

options.title: Keep unified Chat as the sole conversation surface
options.body: Retain realtime Talk as a Chat action, then adapt the reference shell so it does not add a competing Talk mode.

options.title: Adopt Assistant Chat/Talk modes
options.body: Approve the persistent Assistant submode and update the unified Chat/voice work to make its session, mic, and activity contracts explicit.

options.title: Defer the visual shell
options.body: Land the unified Chat/voice foundation first and revisit the phone shell against the resulting interaction model.

recommendation.title: Keep unified Chat as the sole conversation surface
recommendation.body: Retain realtime Talk as a Chat action, then adapt the reference shell so it does not add a competing Talk mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and have already reviewed the proposed iOS presentation with direct simulator evidence.
